desc: Paper notes on the ground (TTYD_NOTES_TEST: four notes round Mario in Rogueport's harbour, no relay): from a distance, none near enough to read. A plain one, a gold one (rated +5), one of this device's (blue) and one by the fence at the left; each a folded sheet lifted off the ground with its shadow (now and then a glint at its corner), none cut by the fence, and nothing drawn over them: no "!" (the game's press-A mark), checked in the log of what the notes drew
